sys.path[:0] = ['/work/engine/src','/work/engine']
import engine.catalogue as catalogue
original = catalogue.get_nsfs_with_cap

def a6_get_nsfs_with_cap(capabilities):
    result = original(capabilities)
    if capabilities == ['HttpReqHdrUserAgentConditionCapability']:
        headers = set(original(['HttpReqHdrConditionCapability']))
        rejects = set(original(['RejectActionCapability']))
        if 'Squid' not in headers or 'Squid' not in rejects:
            raise RuntimeError('A6 mapping refused: live Squid header/reject capability absent')
        result = sorted(set(result) | {'Squid'})
